messages:
Ivy (Comms): All-hands in 12. Two quick asks: trim the roadmap to two bullets, and confirm recording + stream fallback plan.
Sam (Infra): Encoder looks stable. If we see a drop: ```ssh encoder && sudo systemctl restart streamd``` 9s restart. I also staged a fallback key.
Rox (AV): Lectern mic cable is flaky; I have a lav and a handheld. Lav preferred for clean sound, handheld if speaker moves.
Ivy (Comms): Hugo wants a 90s opening, then 8-10m live Q&A. If audio is poor for remote callers we'll pull them into the bridge and mute livestream voice.
Hugo (CEO): Yep short intro: call out Dedicated perf uplift and Private compliance checklist. Two bullets only. Then Q&A; keep answers concise.
Eve (Product): Slides uploaded: "AH_short_2bullets.pdf" pinned in agenda. I'll prep two quick Qs: caching wins and pricing pilot.
Rox (AV): Setting monitor mute for first 20s to avoid bleed. If I swap to lav levels will change slightlyI'll balance before start.
Sam (Infra): Fallback command to switch keys: ```curl -X POST http://encoder/api/switch_key -d 'key=FALLBACK_KEY_2012'``` 9s to apply. I'll stand by.
rec-bot: Reminder: recording scheduled to start in 8 minutes. Please keep mics muted until hosts cue.
Ivy (Comms): Action items: (1) Rox swap to lav if XLR flaps, (2) Sam have restart & fallback key ready, (3) Hugo & Eve rehearse 90s handoff. React with :white_check_mark: when ready.
Rox (AV): :white_check_mark: lav ready on channel 4, monitor muted
Sam (Infra): :white_check_mark: commands ready, watching metrics
Eve (Product): :white_check_mark: 2 bullets rehearsed
rec-bot: Recording started at 2012345780
Ivy (Comms): Thanks team  see you in the room.
